name: Planting Seeds For The Harvest
overview: Scripture teaches that God ordains the natural order of seedtime and harvest as a continual process sustaining life on earth (Genesis 8:22). Believers are called to faithfully sow spiritual seeds, even amid trials and apparent delay, trusting that diligent labor will result in rejoicing at the harvest (Psalms 126:6; Galatians 6:9). The imagery of a tree planted by water that endures drought and yields fruit illustrates the sustaining power of abiding in Christ, the true vine, under the care of the heavenly husbandman (Jeremiah 17:8; John 15:1). Ultimately, God’s timing governs the separation of good from evil at the harvest, emphasizing patient endurance and trust in His sovereign judgment (Matthew 13:30).
